description: Ex-SAAF 35 Squadron, grounded 22 November 1977. Hoisted onto the roof of Vic's Viking Garage on 5 March 1987, replacing the Vickers Viking ZS-DKH that had stood there since January 1963. The garage passed to Sasol in 2004 and the aircraft has been repainted successively in SAAF, Coca-Cola and Sasol schemes; it is not in service colours. Still in place in Sasol livery in a dated photograph of 25 September 2022, photographed on the roof on 20 September 2018 with a coordinate fix on the airframe, and shown in place in a June 2024 blog post. Roof mounting, no access to the airframe itself, but fully visible from the R553.
